variants.headline: See this {workflow} workflow on your own sources.
variants.body: Bring one recurring {workflow} task. We will show the finished work product, the source attached to each figure, and where your review rules stop release.

variants.headline: Who reviews this work at your firm today?
variants.body: A scoped {workflow} demo starts from the systems you already run and ends with a reviewed draft, source attached, ready for the owner who signs off.

variants.headline: Bring us the workflow behind this question.
variants.body: One workflow, the systems behind it, and the person who reviews the result. We scope the smallest proof that returns finished work product under your review rules.

variants.headline: Finished work product, source attached, released by your reviewer.
variants.body: We build and run the {workflow} workflow above your system of record. Your team keeps approval; every material answer links back to its source.
